{
  "tests": [
    {
      "requirement": "R4",
      "code": "import pytest

def test_r4_public_names_exist():
    import arrow
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'DateTimeParser')
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'ParserError')
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'TypeError')
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'error')
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'JapaneseLocale')
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'Arrow')
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'ArrowFactory')
    assert hasattr(arrow, 'get')
    assert hasattr(arrow.Arrow, 'humanize')
    assert hasattr(arrow.Arrow, 'span_range')

def test_r4_no_deprecated_timestamp_property():
    import arrow
    import inspect
    assert not isinstance(arrow.Arrow.timestamp, property)
    assert callable(arrow.Arrow.timestamp)
    assert hasattr(arrow.Arrow, 'int_timestamp')
    assert hasattr(arrow.Arrow, 'float_timestamp')
    assert callable(arrow.Arrow.int_timestamp)
    assert callable(arrow.Arrow.float_timestamp)

def test_r4_type_error_is_builtin():
    import arrow
    assert arrow.TypeError is TypeError

def test_r4_error_is_exception():
    import arrow
    assert issubclass(arrow.error, Exception)
"
    },
    {
      "requirement": "R5",
      "code": "import pytest

def test_r5_out_of_range_timestamp_raises():
    import arrow
    with pytest.raises((OverflowError, ValueError, OSError)):
        arrow.get(1e20)
    with pytest.raises((OverflowError, ValueError, OSError)):
        arrow.Arrow.fromtimestamp(1e20)

def test_r5_negative_out_of_range_raises():
    import arrow
    with pytest.raises((OverflowError, ValueError, OSError)):
        arrow.get(-1e20)

def test_r5_valid_timestamp_works():
    import arrow
    a = arrow.get(0)
    assert a is not None
    assert a.timestamp() == 0
    b = arrow.get(2**31 - 1)
    assert b is not None
"
    },
    {
      "requirement": "R6",
      "code": "import pytest

def test_r6_span_accepts_exact():
    import arrow
    a = arrow.get('2023-01-01 10:30:45')
    span_default = a.span('hour')
    span_exact = a.span('hour', exact=True)
    assert len(span_exact) == 2
    assert span_exact[0] == a
    assert span_exact[1] == a.shift(hours=1)

def test_r6_span_range_accepts_exact():
    import arrow
    start = arrow.get('2023-01-01 10:00:00')
    end = arrow.get('2023-01-01 12:00:00')
    spans_exact = list(arrow.Arrow.span_range('hour', start, end, exact=True))
    assert len(spans_exact) > 0
    assert spans_exact[0][0] == start
    assert spans_exact[-1][1] == end

def test_r6_interval_accepts_exact():
    import arrow
    start = arrow.get('2023-01-01 10:00:00')
    end = arrow.get('2023-01-01 12:00:00')
    intervals_exact = list(arrow.Arrow.interval('hour', start, end, exact=True))
    assert len(intervals_exact) > 0
    assert intervals_exact[0][0] == start
    assert intervals_exact[-1][1] == end

def test_r6_exact_default_false():
    import arrow
    a = arrow.get('2023-01-01 10:30:45')
    span_default = a.span('hour')
    assert span_default[0] != a
"

R5 tests use large timestamps to trigger platform-specific errors. R6 tests assume that exact=True makes span start at the original time and end after one unit, and that span_range/interval respect start and end boundaries. All tests import arrow inside each function to avoid module-level side effects."
}
